messages:
incident-bot: PAGER ▶ Sev2 - embedder KV cache eviction spike in us-west-2 causing 5-10% tail latency increase for hosted text-gen API. Pages routed to #eng-sre oncall.
oncall-maya: On it. Collecting traces now. Moving traffic to fallback model variant for affected customers. Notifying CS and product.
ravi: Seeing eviction rate jump tied to last kernel patch deploy at 09:48z. Reproduced locally on a small shard.
kevin: If rollback needed, we should also prepare capacity bump on Dedicated to absorb traffic. Quick estimate: rollback verification + canary ~3h dev + 2h validation.
sara-pm: Please capture customer impact list. We should schedule a post-incident review and create follow-ups tied to Q2 reliability OKR.
alex-sre: Proposed immediate mitigations: rollback candidate to previous kernel (1h), enable fallback routing (done), throttle eviction via config. Longer term: revise eviction heuristics.
jen-support: Sending affected-customer list to the thread. Drafting proactive comms; will need approval from product.
oncall-maya: Rollback initiated at 10:12Z. Early metrics show tail latency back to baseline and errors cleared. Marking mitigated but leaving page open for post-incident actions.
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> severity downgraded to Sev3.
incident-bot: Post-incident review scheduled: 2026-03-19 21:00Z (14:00 PT). Attendees: eng-sre, eng-runtime, product, support.
ravi: For remediation sizing: eviction heuristics rewrite ~1.5 engineer-weeks (owner + review), eviction circuit-breaker flag ~2 engineer-days, add finer eviction telemetry ~3 engineer-days. Will put estimates in tickets.
sara-pm: Prioritization proposal: heuristics rewrite = P0 (Q2 reliability), circuit-breaker = P1, telemetry = P2. I'll add them to the sprint planning board and link to OKR.
alex-sre: Also propose a short-term canary policy: auto-rollback if eviction rate > 0.5% over 5m for critical fleets. Config + CI tests ~1 day. Marking as P0 small task.
kevin: For tracking: create JIRA EPIC for this incident, child tickets for each action item, assign SLO owners and expected delivery dates.
jen-support: I'll prepare the customer comms template and who to notify. Will post draft in #support-drafts and link here before the postmortem.
oncall-maya: Creating remediation tickets now and assigning owners. Will attach logs and the rollback runbook to the EPIC.
sara-pm: Thanks team — during the postmortem let's agree on rollout guardrails and the exact acceptance criteria for the heuristics change so we can unblock Q2 planning.
alex-sre: Noted. Also adding a telemetry dashboard for eviction metrics by model+region (short term) and per-route alerts (medium term).
incident-bot: Action items summary will be exported to the incident EPIC. Postmortem invite + agenda sent to attendees.
